xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5343: Workflow redesign H: All projects deck — list active conversations across projects, show 1–4 side by side

plan.title: Workflow redesign H: All projects deck — list active conversations across projects, show 1–4 side by side
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One operator-approved mockup (docs/design/multi-conversation-mockup.html) for one child (H) of epic PAN-5284, which the operator already decomposed into children A-H. Every item depends on the same three foundations (the All deck key, Home-less decks in panesStore, the deck layout store), and the list files (ConversationList/ConversationRow/ConversationsSection) and Stage files (Stage/index, PaneBar, PaneLayoutView) are mutated in sequence; splitting would ship a deck that cannot open conversations beside each other. The surface is ~30 source/test files in one subsystem (src/dashboard/frontend) plus four docs files.

narratives.Problem: The operator works in several conversations across several projects at once. A conversation always opens in its own project's deck, so clicking a DFAI conversation switches away from overdeck, there is no list of active conversations across projects, and there is no quick way to see 2-4 conversations side by side with equal panes.
narratives.Proposal: Add an All projects deck (key '__all-projects__') reachable from the project switcher and a This project / All projects switch in the Conversations section. Its list shows every project's conversations (Needs you first, then one group per project, pane-number badges). The deck has no Home pane, shows 1, 2, 3 or a 2x2 grid of conversations from any projects (Layout presets), and opens conversations beside each other by Ctrl/Cmd+Click, a hover Beside button, a row-menu item or dragging a row onto a pane. Layout and focus history move into a store so the left column and the top bar can use them, panesStore gains Home-less decks, and a reload flag keeps the All deck across /conv/ reloads.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No collapsing of project groups.
- Layout presets arrange agent panes only; no code, terminal or issue panes in presets.
- No change to Ctrl+Alt+1..9 pane focus.
- No per-pane Needs-you banners or compact pane headers beyond what ConversationPanel already shows.
- No 'Open here' row-menu item.
- Conversation-reference links in transcripts (ConversationLinkOpener) keep opening in the conversation's own project deck.
- No change to the project-deck crumb or to the project-deck plain click.
- No change to the mobile conversation list (components/mobile/).
- No server or API change and no new polling.
- Never POST projectKey '__all-projects__' to the server.
- No allowlist raise in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt.

autoDecisions.summary: Layout and focus history move from Stage state to a new zustand deckLayoutStore (H-D14) instead of exposing openers on StageDeckContext.
autoDecisions.rationale: The left column, the top-bar crumb and the row badges render outside the Stage, so a Stage-only context cannot serve them; the store keeps the pan-layout:<deck> key and rule so existing tests hold.

autoDecisions.summary: The All deck is a Home-less deck inside panesStore (H-D15) rather than 'skip ensureHome'.
autoDecisions.rationale: Hydration only happens in ensureHome and addPane seeds a Home pane over persisted panes; skipping it would lose the deck on reload and closing the last pane would throw.

autoDecisions.summary: A separate localStorage flag overdeck.ui.allProjectsDeck restores the All deck on a /conv/ or storage-fallback reload (H-D16).
autoDecisions.rationale: Focusing a pane writes /conv/<id> and initialProjectKey returns null for /conv/ paths, so without the flag a reload selects the conversation's own project and FR-5/AC-15 fail.

autoDecisions.summary: Open beside (Ctrl/Cmd+Click, Beside, drag to an edge) rebuilds an equal preset grid of the visible panes plus the new one, up to four; at four it replaces the least recently focused leaf. The same rule applies in project decks.
autoDecisions.rationale: Repeated splitAtLeaf gives 1/2,1/4,1/8,1/8 widths, which contradicts the approved mockup's equal grid and NFR-3; one rule in every deck is simpler to test and explain.

autoDecisions.summary: Row drag keeps the existing centre-replaces / edge-opens-beside drop zones instead of the mockup's left-half/right-half split.
autoDecisions.rationale: Tab drags already use those zones; one drop vocabulary avoids two meanings for the same overlay.

autoDecisions.summary: The row menu adds 'Open beside' and 'Open in its project' (from the mockup notes); 'Open here' is not added.
autoDecisions.rationale: A plain click already does 'Open here'; the mockup notes name only the other two.

autoDecisions.summary: Each split header gets a 'Make this the only pane' (⤢) button in every deck.
autoDecisions.rationale: The approved mockup's grid scene shows it and it is the only quick way back to one pane besides the Layout bar.

autoDecisions.summary: In grouped mode only the Inbox rows are grouped by project; Needs you, Snoozed and Settled keep their sections and prefix each row with its project mark.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the existing triage sections intact while matching the mockup's 'Needs you first, then per-project groups' for the default Active filter.

autoDecisions.summary: Pane-number badges show in every deck whenever its layout has two or more leaves, not only in the All deck.
autoDecisions.rationale: The mockup renders the badge whenever more than one pane is shown, and the rule is the same for project decks.

autoDecisions.summary: The All deck crumb shows the active pane label with 0-1 leaves (falling back to 'Conversation'), and 'N conversations side by side' with 2+ leaves.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the existing project-deck crumb, which shows the active pane label; the mockup's literal 'Conversation' is its placeholder.

autoDecisions.summary: ALL_PROJECTS_KEY lives in a new import-free leaf module FE/lib/deckKeys.ts, re-exported by projectsData.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: panesStore must import the key; importing projectsData from panesStore would pull in wsTransport and risks a lint:circular failure.

autoDecisions.summary: Planned as one issue with 21 items instead of sibling issues; plan.metadata.sizeJustification states why.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator already split the epic into children A-H and approved this child's mockup as one unit; every item hangs off the same deck key, Home-less panes and layout store, and the list/Stage files are mutated in sequence.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5 (H-D6). New src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/Stage/openConversationInDeck.ts exporting showConversation(deckKey, name, label): string and openConversationBeside(deckKey, name, label): string. Both use usePanesStore.getState() and useDeckLayoutStore.getState() only (no React), call ensureHome(deckKey) and getLayout(deckKey) first, and read the active pane id BEFORE adding a pane. showConversation: a visible conversation is only focused; otherwise find-or-add its agent pane and, when the layout has >=2 leaves, replaceLeaf the focused leaf (active id if it is a leaf, else the first leaf). openConversationBeside: visible = layout leaves, or [activeId] for a null layout with an active pane, or []; visible already holding the conversation -> focus only; else find-or-add the pane; 0 visible -> done; 1..3 visible -> setLayout(presetLayout([...visible, paneId], visible.length+1)); 4 visible -> replaceLeaf the least recently focused leaf other than the active one (oldest focus-history index; never-focused counts oldest; ties go to the later leaf in leaf order). Both end with setActivePane(deckKey, paneId) and noteFocus(deckKey, paneId) and return paneId.
